title: Formal Algebraic, Combinatorial, and Rational-Enclosure Certification for Trifferent Codes
abstract: We present a machine-checked constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel and zero-float exact rational certificate suite (TRIFF-CERT-1.0) auditing key algebraic, coding-theoretic, binary-box, and exact-logarithm pillars of Bhandari and Khetan's improved trifferent code bounds T(n) = Omega(1.162579^n) and T(n) = O(n^{-1/2}(3/2)^n) (arXiv:2611.33212v1). Our artifact combines 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier over Z and Q, 16 canonical JSON certificates (C01-C16), and 37 unit and forgery-rejection tests. Inside Lean we prove the 9-word tetracode's constant distance 3 and rainbow-iff-distinct equivalence over F_3^4, AGL(1,9) invertibility and injectivity (hence bijectivity) on F_3^2, the factorial cardinality formula 9*8*(fact 14/(fact 4 * fact 3)) = 43589145600, 1.162579^4 > 9/5, Appendix A.2 port-cut identities (69/224, 31/64, 31/56, 93/224), Section 3.6 inequalities C(t,3) >= 3t-8, ternary Turan, and n*D <= 96*Z, and Appendix A.4's 1 - chi^2 >= 8/9 enclosure bound. In Python we independently verify AGL(1,9) sharp 2-transitivity, exact pair counts H_0..H_14 via binomial inversion, first-principles Lemma 3.2 central-hole contradiction across all 48 sign configurations on Eq. (25), exact 3^n binary-box counts on finite trifferent codes through n=5, and Appendix A.4 exact rational logarithm enclosures certifying N_bar > 1.162579^n at blocklengths n = 124k (k >= 1).
